thread:
Leah (CSM): heads up — BrightFolio hit a usage cliff this week, DAU down ~32% vs last week. looks like onboarding stalled after their second integration task. tagging team for a quick winback plan :wave:
Matt (AM): ugh. saw the same in the dashboard. renewal window in 18 days, at-risk tier. they mentioned cost concerns on last call.
Leah (CSM): proposal: 10-day bite-sized recovery sprint (not a full playbook). goal = stabilize core integration, unblock usage, present a 30-day value snapshot ahead of renewal. quick owners: Matt = pricing talk + offer, Jordan = KPI dashboard + usage snapshot, Eva = 15-min enablement workshop + playbook link.
Jordan (RevOps): I can pull a delta report: top 3 missing events, last 7 day retention, and a per-seat utilization heatmap. will drop CSV + link by EOD.
Eva (Enablement): I’ll prep a 15-min "restart" workshop + a 1-pager checklist. Offer to run it with their dev lead. include two remediation scripts and the common integration error logs.
Leah (CSM): Matt — what are we comfortable offering to keep them on the standard plan? thinking: 2 weeks of grace credits + 10% off first month if they agree to the workshop and success targets.
Matt (AM): fine with that. conditioned on workshop + a light commitment (2 checkpoints). I’ll draft the offer email.
Leah (CSM): ok owners assigned. quick timeline: Day 0 = outreach + offer, Day 2 = workshop, Day 4 = small fixes, Day 8 = usage snapshot, Day 10 = renewal prep doc.
CS Assist Bot: Reminder: customer BrightFolio (acct BF-9921) renewal in 18 days. Playbook template: https://console.redwood.example/playbooks/recovery-sprint-template
Leah (CSM): Jordan — include a baseline metric we can show in the renewal slide: active workflows, avg tokens per run, error rate. we need to quantify the delta they can expect if the fixes land.
Jordan (RevOps): noted. baseline table + projected uplift using our conservative model. I'll attach the charts.
Eva (Enablement): draft workshop agenda: 1) quick health check (5m) 2) config gaps (5m) 3) live fix on a sample flow (5m). deliverables: checklist + 2 troubleshooting snippets.
Leah (CSM): include a short feedback capture at the end — one-click NPS + free-text on top friction. capture link to send in follow-up.
Matt (AM): suggested email copy (first pass):
```
Subject: Quick 15-min restart + limited credit for BrightFolio
Hi Team — we saw a drop in usage and want to help get you back on track. Can we do a 15-min workshop this week? If you join + hit the two quick checkpoints we’ll apply 2 weeks of credit and a promo for month 1.
—Matt
```
Leah (CSM): nice. add explicit acceptance criteria: workshop completed + two checkpoints within 10 days.
Jordan (RevOps): I uploaded the CSV and a short dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.example/bf-9921/delta (internal only).
Eva (Enablement): Here are the two troubleshooting snippets I’ll include in the workshop:
```
# Reconnect: force-refresh token
curl -X POST "https://api.brightfolio.example/v1/refresh" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

# Small batch replay
python replay_events.py --from-date=2026-03-01 --to-date=2026-03-10 --chunk-size=50
```
Leah (CSM): good. add a short downgrade-mitigant: if they still need to reduce seats, propose a phased downgrade path that preserves critical workflows (ensure 1:1 mapping of workflows -> seats) and a short runbook for export. we want them to stay even if they downsize.
Matt (AM): agree. I'll include a "soft-downgrade" slide that lists what to keep and what to deprioritize. also include a limited-cost alternative (quantization/limits) to reduce spend instead of cutting seats.
Leah (CSM): follow-ups: 1) Matt send offer email today (owner Matt) 2) Jordan share slides + metric snapshot (owner Jordan) 3) Eva schedule workshop + send calendar options (owner Eva) 4) Leah will run the renewal prep doc with AE.
Jordan (RevOps): will get items ready by EOD.
Eva (Enablement): will send out 3 calendar slots for the 15-min session.
Matt (AM): email drafted, sending now. cc Leah. :white_check_mark:
Leah (CSM): after workshop we’ll push a short feedback form and the initiative will be flagged as "recovery-sprint-2698" in Salesforce so we can track conversion.
CS Assist Bot: Action logged: recovery-sprint-2698 created, owner Leah (CSM), linked to BF-9921.
Leah (CSM): perfect. if anything changes ping here. otherwise we’ll use this thread for quick updates only. :spiral_calendar:
